declared.hypothesis: fused HGP F (kernel_f, literal) is faster than MMD J + K (DQ + [p|q] + JAB, literal, one batch; kernel_kblock) for (ss|ss) and (pp|pp) on gly5, gly10 and gly15 / 6-31G
declared.rule: per (molecule, class, card): 'fused' when q3(f) < q1(mmd), 'split' when q3(mmd) < q1(f), else 'unresolved'; the hypothesis holds on a card when all six cells read 'fused'. f_block_fab is reported beside it and decides nothing.
declared.expected: fused everywhere: every molecule is under [Fock, §6.1]'s ~3,000-function crossover; the ratio mmd/f across n is the reading
